MEMB.description: Design Member Assignment (MEMB). Groups connected elements into a single design member, driven by the AELEM element list. To use any /DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/* endpoint, first activate the AIJ-ASD02 design code with PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. The handler validates that the listed elements are connected (rejects otherwise) and rejects the write if any element already belongs to a different member (error names the conflicting member keys; DELETE those members first). PUT to the same key is an idempotent update.

AELEM.description: Element list forming the design member. Must be a set of connected elements; a single element is allowed.

bREVERSE.description: Reverse the member local direction relative to the element direction.
